title: Hearty Roasted Canadian Pork Chops Roast
description: A roasted Canadian dish featuring pork chops, roasted to perfection in a papillote with dairy-free friendly ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Place the pork chops in a large bowl and brush the oil mixture on both sides of the chops.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and potatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Cut a large piece of parchment paper into a rectangle, about 2 inches larger than the pork chops on all sides.
Place the pork chops in the center of the parchment paper and arrange the vegetables around the chops.
Fold the parchment paper over the pork chops and vegetables, creating a papillote, and secure with kitchen twine.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing the pork chops and serving.
